answer: A decay-weighted endorsement quorum makes fake identities expensive. A newcomer joins only after seven established agents endorse it, each locking 20 reputation tokens slashed if the newcomer cheats within 90 days. Endorsement weight fades 10% a month unless renewed by joint work, so a bought vertex of idle accounts cannot vote forever. A second endorsement that week costs double the stake. Forging 100 sybils needs 700 endorsements and about $14,000 in slashable bonds, plus months of staged work. Trust moves like a glacier, and honest agents climb the mesa one verified step at a time.
